notes.title: V0.4.0 Release!
notes.content:
It's here! V0.4.0 is ready for you! This update brings a lot of new content, both story wise and side content wise. It brings the return of the club in its new and improved form, with repeatable scenes for both the male and female versions of the MC. As with Episode 1, more content will be added to the club over time.

Speaking of the female MC, once you've spend enough time as her, you will gain the ability to toggle between male and female anytime in the navigation menu once you speak to Phoenix!

This is quite a big update, but there's one giant character making her return. Fans of Hillda will be able to find her once again and she even has a repeatable scene!

Of course, there's all the normal story content that's included with each update, with two new scenes for each of the seven main characters. I won't spoil any of that here, but I hope you enjoy it! A lot of storylines are rocketing forward!

Finally, keep your eye on the phone. Someone might text the wrong number accidentally...

I'm sure there's more things, but well, you don't want to read more, just go play the update!

Edit:

Updated to [b]V0.4.3[/b]. This fixes a bug in the club when talking to Carter, issues with crashes when accessing the MC's PC, a whole sexy scene with Amy missing from her non futa route, as well as showing a futa render despite having futa content turned off and an issue with being unable to message Amber in the week.

notes.title: V0.3 Steam Release
notes.content:
It's here! V0.3 is now available. This update contains a couple of rather big things. A couple of note is seeing the club starting to re-open as well as another bodyswap scene, since that was so popular last time. 

Once you reach a certain point in the story, you can freeroam as the female version of the MC. Obviously, you cannot continue any story scenes while female, nor can you do some of the normal repeatable scenes, but there are some spicy scenes for this mode, as well as a couple of alternatives for the simple round the house scenes. If you want to swap to the female form, make sure you have genderswap content turned on and go visit Phoenix. 

I also put a lot of work into reworking the character profiles. Now they are not split into multiple pages, but a single page you can scroll. It looks so much cleaner like that. I added ages to everyone too, in case anyone was wondering exactly how old everybody is.

Also, new preference options were added, so make sure you check those to keep your preferences aligned with the content you want to see.

notes.title: V0.2 Release
notes.content:
It's finally here, a little later than planned, but here none the less. Anyone that is on Discord or has seen previous posts knows I've been mega busy IRL over the course of this update. I got married in another country, that was incredible, and also got a puppy! As you can imagine, that has been pure chaos, which of course has impacted development. Thankfully, I still managed to get all the story content I wanted to add into this update, as well as some side content, but there was some side content that had to be cut. Don't worry, that'll be coming in future updates, I haven't abandoned it.

- PTGames

notes.title: V0.2 Progress Update
notes.content:
Hi!

I thought I'd just quickly write a post to give you all an update on how V0.2 is coming along. First of all though, I want to say thank you to everyone that has bought Episode 2 so far. I am blown away by the support you guys have shown. I've identified a couple of issues players have had and addressed them for V0.2.

The biggest issue is that some players have been unable to find the content preferences menu. I've had a few complaints about being unable to disable futa content, as well as other types of content. I believe this has arisen mostly for two reasons. 1. People skipping the intro, which is where the existence of this menu is explained and 2. The game dropping you straight into the MC's bedroom, which naturally causes players to begin playing.

So, from V0.2 onwards, I'll be removing the skip intro option (since you can just press tab or hold control to speed through it anyway) as well as having the intro drop you directly into the preferences menu. This should hopefully mean players will see they can disable most content types they dislike.

As for the actual content of V0.2, I'm working on more story content for each character as I usually do, but I'm also working on adding in more repeatable events. A few that didn't fit from Episode 1, due to things like location changes, were removed and need adding back. For example, Sandra's repeatable scenes were set in the basement, but she is no longer there. I've recreated them in V0.2 in her new location.

I've also started working on some other new repeatable events. Part of the goal of Episode 2 is to avoid one of the issues in V0.1 where you often found yourself needing to skip time to get to events. I've set up the events so it'll be rare you'll have to skip more than to the next day to find an event, but I also want it so when you do need to skip time, there's interesting things to do instead of just clicking a button to advance time.

So, with that in mind, I'm aiming on filling the world with a lot of repeatable events. The aim is that at any time on any day, there'll be at least a couple of repeatable events for you to choose from across a whole range of characters. You can see the foundation for this is already in game with a lot of passive events with characters around the house. I hope to flesh these out into more interesting events in future and will be focusing a little bit on this with each update.

Finally, if you're wondering when V0.2 will be released, it'll be a little while. I'm going to be extremely busy over the next month, which may slow development down a little. My usual update schedule is once every 3 months or so, but this may be closer to 4. It entirely depends on how much I get done in the next couple of weeks!

I hope you're all excited, I'm really looking forward to where the story is going to go in the next couple of updates and peoples reactions to it!

- PTGames
